text: Pooling matched seeds 56-64 at e <= 0.5 and reading every N=64 and N=256 formation step from the trajectories, is the mean N=256 minus N=64 delay on the 0.1 bar and the half-final measure different from 0 by more than one checkpoint (10 steps)? Seeds 56-58 gave +20/+70/+30, but seeds 62-64 gave only 0-20.
